title: Understanding k-Medians
text: In k-Medians clustering, the center of each cluster is the median of the data points in that cluster. This is different from k-Means, where the center is the mean. Think about how the median is calculated and how it might affect the cluster centers.

title: First Iteration Check
text: To determine if k-Medians has converged, check if the cluster centers have changed after assigning data points to the nearest center. If they remain the same, it has converged. Otherwise, it hasn't.

title: Calculating New Medians
text: After assigning each data point to the nearest cluster center, calculate the median of each cluster. What are the new medians?

title: Assigning Data Points
text: Assign each data point to the nearest cluster center. For example, data point $$1$$ is closer to center $$2$$ than to center $$7$$. Do this for all data points.
